description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of two methods—labeled "Standard" and "Ours"—across two categories, "CORG" and "AdaCAD," with a third, unlabeled category on the far left. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 48 to 62, with horizontal gridlines at intervals of 2. The horizontal axis displays the three categories. For the first category, the "Standard" method (gray bar) has a performance of approximately 59.5, while the "Ours" method (blue bar) is not shown. For the "CORG" category, the "Standard" method has a performance of approximately 52.5, and the "Ours" method has a performance of approximately 60.5. For the "AdaCAD" category, the "Standard" method has a performance of approximately 54.5, and the "Ours" method has a performance of approximately 60.5. The "Ours" method consistently shows higher performance than the "Standard" method in the "CORG" and "AdaCAD" categories. The legend indicates that the gray bars represent the "Standard" method and the blue bars represent the "Ours" method.
